screenshot.camera_description: Camera movement, overlays and queued screenshots. Retrieve completed frame metadata with action=screenshot_status and requestId.
screenshot.camera_actions: Camera action: get_view, set_active_world, set_view, move, switch_view, focus_cell, focus_dupe, screenshot, coordinate_screenshot, or screenshot_status.
screenshot.invalid_action: Unknown camera action. Use get_view, set_active_world, set_view, move, switch_view, focus_cell, focus_dupe, screenshot, coordinate_screenshot, or screenshot_status.
screenshot.navigation_invalid: Use domain=camera and a supported camera action, including screenshot_status for an existing requestId.
screenshot.request_id: Screenshot request ID returned by capture acceptance; required for screenshot_status.
screenshot.wait_frames: Render frames to wait before capture: 1 to 30, default 2 (coordinate_screenshot: 3). This is not a completion guarantee; poll screenshot_status by requestId.
screenshot.capture_description: Compatibility entrypoint. Prefer navigation_control action=screenshot, then screenshot_status with requestId. Capture acceptance does not mean the PNG is ready.
screenshot.filename: Optional PNG filename. A filename in use by a pending screenshot is rejected.
screenshot.switch_description: Compatibility entrypoint. Prefer navigation_control action=switch_view. For screenshots, retrieve completion and actual frame metadata with screenshot_status and requestId.
screenshot.coordinate_description: Compatibility entrypoint. Prefer navigation_control action=coordinate_screenshot for visible world coordinate labels. Retrieve the finished PNG and actual camera context with screenshot_status and requestId.
screenshot.next: Poll navigation_control action=screenshot_status requestId=<requestId>. Only status=complete with imageState=verified identifies the finished PNG. requested fields are reservation-time values; captured fields describe its frame. latestUrl can change.
screenshot.coordinate_next: Poll navigation_control action=screenshot_status with requestId before opening the PNG. Use its visible coordinate labels for cell lookup; the requested rectangle is not proof of rendered coverage.
screenshot.coordinate_system: ONI world absolute x/y; grid lines bound cell edges; labels are world cell coordinates.
screenshot.area_too_large: Area too large for a coordinate screenshot: {0}x{1}={2}, maxCells={3}.
screenshot.rect_world_mismatch: The requested rectangle center is not in worldId={0}.
screenshot.error_game_unavailable: No loaded game is available for a screenshot.
screenshot.error_camera_unavailable: The rendering camera is not available.
screenshot.error_queue_full: The screenshot queue is full. Wait for a pending request to finish.
screenshot.error_filename_busy: A pending screenshot already uses this filename.
screenshot.error_context_changed: The loaded game or active scene changed before capture.
screenshot.error_overlay_unavailable: The overlay controller is not available.
screenshot.error_capture_unavailable: The screenshot frame could not be read.
screenshot.error_capture_failed: The screenshot could not be completed.
screenshot.error_request_id: A valid screenshot request ID is required.
screenshot.error_timeout: The screenshot did not reach a capture frame before its deadline.
screenshot.error_host_unavailable: The screenshot queue is not available.
